svg.aria-label: Skill distance = the extent of re-training needed to move from one job to another. A journey map: a marketing manager holding a megaphone and a bar chart stands at the start. A short, smooth green road with one training stop (a book) leads, with an arrow, to a sales manager offering a handshake beside a target chart; a short ruler marks it as short: small skill distance, a little re-training. A long, winding dashed road with four training stops (books, a graduation cap, an online laptop course and a certificate) leads, with an arrow, to a software developer working at a desk on a laptop showing code; a long measuring tape marks it as long: large skill distance, a lot of re-training.
svg.title: Skill distance
svg.text: Skill distance = the extent of re-training needed
to move from one job to another
